tests.name: dump_scalars_and_types
tests.intent: Probes serialization of basic scalar types (null, boolean, integers, floating point numbers) through dump() method.

tests.name: dump_short_and_long_strings
tests.intent: Probes serialization of strings of various lengths including short plain strings optimized by the PR and escaped characters.

tests.name: dump_ensure_ascii_multibyte
tests.intent: Probes serialization of multibyte unicode strings with ensure_ascii enabled to exercise fast escaping paths.

tests.name: dump_containers_pretty_and_compact
tests.intent: Probes serialization of nested objects and arrays in both compact and pretty-printed indent modes.

tests.name: dump_binary_values
tests.intent: Probes serialization of binary byte containers with and without custom subtypes in compact and pretty formats.

tests.name: ordered_json_serialization
tests.intent: Probes preservation of key insertion order using nlohmann::ordered_json dump formatting.

tests.name: deep_nesting_iterative_dump
tests.intent: Probes serialization of deeply nested json structures that exceed recursion depth limits and trigger iterative dumping.

tests.name: serializer_custom_output_stream
tests.intent: Probes writing json directly to a standard output stream adapter using serializer and stream operators.

tests.name: serializer_direct_escaped_check
tests.intent: Probes direct usage of serializer's internal dump_escaped helper function via testability macro access.

tests.name: empty_containers_dump
tests.intent: Probes correct serialization of empty objects and arrays in both compact and indented formats.

tests.name: to_string_format_as_helpers
tests.intent: Probes conversion of json objects to strings using to_string and format_as helper functions.

tests.name: scalar_comparisons_and_dump
tests.intent: Probes scalar comparison operators alongside serialization of boundary scalar values.

tests.name: serializer_error_handlers
tests.intent: Probes serializer initialization with different error handler options (strict, ignore, replace).

tests.name: discarded_value_dump
tests.intent: Probes serialization behavior of discarded json values.

tests.name: long_escaped_runs_serialization
tests.intent: Probes serialization of long runs of characters requiring escaping (newlines, tabs, backslashes) to check buffer flushes.

tests.name: floats_special_values_dump
tests.intent: Probes serialization behavior of special floating point values like NaN and infinities if supported.

tests.name: mixed_type_array_pretty_dump
tests.intent: Probes serialization of arrays containing mixed types (objects, strings, arrays, numbers) with custom indentation steps.

tests.name: key_length_boundary_strings
tests.intent: Probes object keys of lengths right around the 16 and 32 byte short string optimization boundaries.

tests.name: istream_json_extraction
tests.intent: Probes stream extraction and insertion roundtrip using standard operators.

tests.name: serializer_indent_step_variations
tests.intent: Probes serializer creation with various indentation steps and indent characters.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercises put_literal_indent and container dump elements with indented objects and arrays using dump(indent_step).

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercises boolean serialization and uninitialized buffer construction members inside dump().

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercises 2-byte UTF-8 character serialization with ensure_ascii to hit validate_one_utf8 2-byte branches and u-escapes.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercises vector-based plain short string copy paths and short string max optimizations by dumping strings of varying small lengths.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercises serializer uninitialized buffers and direct dump_element handling for arrays containing objects and scalars.

tests.name: serializer_direct_escaped_check_fixed
tests.intent: Probes direct usage of serializer's internal dump_escaped helper function via testability macro access.

tests.name: serializer_error_handlers_fixed
tests.intent: Probes serializer initialization with different error handler options (strict, ignore, replace).

tests.name: serializer_indent_step_variations_fixed
tests.intent: Probes serializer creation with various indentation steps and indent characters.

tests.name: serializer_direct_escaped_check_fixed_fixed
tests.intent: Probes direct usage of serializer's internal dump_escaped helper function via testability macro access.
